title: Homogenization of the Navier-Stokes equations in a randomly perforated domain in the inviscid limit
summary: We study the behaviour of the solution $u_\varepsilon$ to the Navier-Stokes equations with vanishing viscosity and a non-slip condition in a randomly perforated domain. We consider the space $\mathbb{R}^3$ where we remove $N$ holes that are i.i.d. distributed. The behaviour depends on the particle size $\varepsilon^α=N^{-α/3}$ and the viscosity $\varepsilon^γ=N^{-γ/3}$ of the fluid. We prove quantitative convergence results to a function $u$, provided that the local Reynolds number is small, in the subcritical ($α+γ>3$) and critical ($α+γ=3$) regime.
